Summary: An ad-hoc payment of not less than 75% of the net bill shall be made within 10 working days, and the remaining payment after final checking within 28 working days of submission.

Summary: A security deposit of 2.5% is deducted from each running and final bill until the total deducted reaches 2.5% of the tendered amount.

Notes: The security deposit is deducted from running bills at 2.5% up to a maximum cap of 2.5% of the tendered amount.
